judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a failing acceptance test and never modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to implement the fix. As a result, `npm test` fails on the newly added acceptance test, and `npm run eslint` likely fails on the un-ignored `require-yield` rule in the test's mock generator. Additionally, the candidate did not update `CHANGELOG.md` as required by the acceptance criteria, and in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` it merely appended a validation link to the old recorded-flaw text instead of replacing it with the new guarantee. Finally, it left behind `.lore/dod.md` and created a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than adding the test to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
